name: Stephen Esponda
prior_offices: Johnson County assessor (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Stephen Esponda is the Johnson County assessor and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. Sheridan Media reported that he advanced from the 2026 primary and was selected in the general election. The Buffalo Bulletin reported his general-election total under the spelling Steve Esonda.
